{{Quote|Just kill him already.|A pirate|<ref name="SC 106" />}}
A [[Gender|female]]<ref name="SC 106 SBT" /> '''pirate''' was a member of [[Captain]]<ref name="SC 106" /> [[Brutus]]'<ref name="SC 106 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]] in the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 106" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> they were present at former [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]'s trial. Originally receiving a [[Death penalty|death sentence]], Silvo was allotted a few [[Time|moments]] for<ref name="SC 106" /> his<ref name="Databank-Captain Silvo">{{Databank|captain-silvo|Captain Silvo}}</ref> [[Right of Last Appeal|last appeal]] after [[pirate]]<ref name="SC 106" /> [[Chaelt]]<ref name="SC 106 AD" /> interceded for him, invoking the [[Pirate's Code]]. As the former captain opened his speech, the female individual interrupted him, calling on their fellow crew members to kill him on spot. Ultimately, Captain Brutus relaxed the verdict, but in exchange for having his life spared, Silvo was to lead the way to [[At Attin]], an isolated [[planet]] allegedly providing infinite supplies of [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="SC 106" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Gender|female]] [[pirate]] first appeared in "[[Zero Friends Again]]," the sixth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''. Despite making their debut as a voice only,<ref name="SC 106" /> the pirate's gender was revealed in the subtitles from [[Disney+]].<ref name="SC 106 SBT" />
